title: Implement export→import round-trip validation test
description: Implement an automated test that exports each round-trip fixture diagram to JSON, re-imports it, and asserts the resulting diagram is identical in structure (tables, columns, types, keys, constraints, indexes, relationships) and layout (x/y/width/height) to the original.
acceptanceCriteria: Test iterates over all round-trip fixture diagrams
For each fixture: serialize → JSON → deserialize → compare structure and layout
Comparison includes table names, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys with referential actions, unique constraints, indexes, and canvas positions
Test reports per-fixture pass/fail and overall pass rate
Test runs in Docker (node:20-alpine) via vitest
100% round-trip fidelity required for all fixtures (per PRD success metric)

statusHistory.reason: Ticket created from PRD US-2.3 acceptance criterion (export→import must produce identical diagram)

evidence: commit:e626f9a TASK-071: add export→import round-trip validation test (branch ticket/TASK-071, not pushed; orchestrator pushes and merges)

created src/__tests__/round-trip-export-import.test.ts — vitest spec that, for each fixture under test/fixtures/round-trip/, deserializes the fixture, serializes to JSON (export), re-imports via JSON.parse + deserializeJson, and compares the re-exported payload against the original in structure and layout (table names, columns, data types, primary keys, foreign keys with onDelete/onUpdate referential actions, unique constraints, indexes, canvas x/y/width/height). createdAt/updatedAt excluded from comparison (regenerated per serialize); comparison done on serialized outputs so deserialization normalizations (unique:false→absent, length:null→absent, name:null→synthetic idx_<col>) do not cause false failures.

docker run node:20-alpine: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npx vitest run src/__tests__/round-trip-export-import.test.ts → 5/5 fixtures PASS (complex-enterprise, composite-pk, edge-cases, self-referencing, unique-constraints-indexes), overall 100.0% round-trip fidelity
docker run node:20-alpine: npx vitest run (full suite) → 35 test files, 453 tests passed, 0 failed
docker run node:20-alpine: npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm run build → tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && vite build succeeded (production build passes, delivery contract satisfied)
